properties.company: Silicon Austria Labs (SAL) — FOWLP pilot line at SAL MicroFab, Villach
properties.site_name: SAL MicroFab, High Tech Campus Villach
properties.summary: Pilot line for fan-out wafer-level packaging, a way to package chips without a substrate. Run by Silicon Austria Labs since 2023.

package_types: automotive/industrial sensor ICs (Hall-effect position/current sensors, sensor interfaces)
properties.summary: Tests and assembles magnetic Hall effect sensor chips for cars and industry at the Melexis headquarters in Ieper, Belgium. The site opened in 1988 and has about 300 employees.

properties.site_name: imec Advanced Packaging / Chiplet Pilot Line (incl. NanoIC, FAMES)
package_types: RDL-based chiplet integration / fan-out redistribution layer
properties.summary: Research pilot line for chiplet packaging with fan-out redistribution layers. It is a research site, not commercial production, with a 2026 start year.
Melexis tests its own chips in Sofia, Bulgaria. The site opened in 2000, employs about 800 people and is expanding.
Sensata assembles high-temperature automotive sensors and mechatronic sensor modules for its own products in Botevgrad. The plant opened in 2011 and has about 250 staff.

properties.site_city: Maritsa Municipality (near Tsaratsovo village), Plovdiv Region
properties.summary: Assembles automotive pressure sensor modules. Opened in 2016 and employs 1,200 people near Plovdiv.

package_types: power modules (thyristors, diodes, GTOs, IGCTs, MOSFETs, IGBTs)
properties.summary: Assembles and tests power modules with thyristors, diodes, IGBTs (insulated gate bipolar transistors) and MOSFETs. Hitachi Energy opened the site in 1953.
Assembles and tests chips in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm, Czech Republic, next to onsemi's silicon and SiC (silicon carbide) wafer fab. About 1,300 people work there, and the site is expanding.

properties.site_name: Murata Vantaa (Murata Electronics Oy technology center)
properties.summary: Murata's own plant for capacitive silicon MEMS (tiny moving sensor) devices, including assembly, packaging and test. It opened in 2002 and has 934 employees.

properties.company: Tampere University (SiPFAB) — Finnish Semiconductor Strategy / Chips JU WBG Pilot Line
properties.site_name: SiPFAB (System-in-Package Pilot Line), Tampere University, Hervanta Campus / Festia Building
package_types: Wide Band Gap (SiC/GaN) power device packaging
properties.summary: Under construction at Tampere University, Finland, for opening in 2027. It is a research and pilot line for chip packaging, including SiC (silicon carbide) and GaN power devices.

properties.company: VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland (Micronova / Kvanttinova, APECS consortium partner)
properties.site_name: VTT Micronova / Kvanttinova (Espoo) - APECS pilot line
properties.summary: VTT in Espoo develops packaging for RF passive devices, radio chips and optical microsystems. Under construction as part of the EU APECS pilot line, with processes planned for late 2026.
Pilot line for 3D integration of FD-SOI (thin silicon-on-insulator) chips, with a 2,000 m² cleanroom. Public research institute, opened in January 2026, not volume production.
Small STMicroelectronics site that assembles chips and tests their long-term reliability for space and aerospace use. About 120 staff were reported around 2016.
Under construction in Tours, France, as a pilot line for panel level chip packaging and test. STMicroelectronics plans to start it in 2026, with an investment above 60 million euros.

properties.company: Fraunhofer ENAS (part of APECS / FMD pilot line)
properties.site_name: Fraunhofer Institute for Electronic Nano Systems ENAS, Chemnitz — APECS advanced packaging R&D pilot line
properties.summary: Public research pilot line for 2.5D and 3D chip packaging, including interposers, chiplets and wafer bonding. It is a research site, not volume production.

properties.site_name: Fraunhofer IPMS Dresden – APECS 300mm Pilot Line (CEASAX / Center Nanoelectronic Technologies)
properties.summary: Fraunhofer IPMS in Dresden assembles and packages chips as research and pilot work. It covers chiplet modules, hybrid bonded stacks, interposers and TSV (through silicon via) packages.

properties.company: Fraunhofer IZM (Fraunhofer Institute for Reliability and Microintegration)
properties.site_name: Fraunhofer IZM - Wafer Level System Integration (WLSI), Berlin
properties.summary: Fraunhofer IZM Berlin runs a research pilot line for wafer-level chip packaging, including fan-out packages and copper wiring layers. It is not a volume production site.

properties.company: Fraunhofer IZM-ASSID (All Silicon System Integration Dresden)
properties.summary: Research and pilot line for chip packaging. It stacks wafers with copper through-silicon vias and builds silicon interposers. Operating since 2010.

properties.site_name: GlobalFoundries Dresden – Final Contacting (Bump and Sort) Facility
properties.summary: Closed GlobalFoundries site that tested wafers and applied zinc silver contact bumps. Trade press reports its work moved to Amkor in Porto, Portugal.
Assembles and tests chip card modules, RFID inlays and sensor packages in Regensburg, Germany. Opened in 1959, it has about 3,000 employees and a 2.5D and 3D packaging pilot.
Infineon's own plant for assembling and testing power modules with IGBT (power switch) and MOSFET chips. Operating since 1945, with 2,200 employees.
Melexis tests and packages chips at its own site in Erfurt, Germany. The site is captive, meaning it serves Melexis products.

properties.company: Robert Bosch GmbH (Bosch Sensortec / Bosch Semiconductor)
properties.site_name: Bosch Reutlingen (wafer fab + on-site Test Center for Semiconductors)
properties.summary: Bosch assembles and tests its own automotive chips, MEMS (micro-electromechanical) sensors and SiC (silicon carbide) power MOSFETs in Reutlingen. About 4,000 staff work at the site.

properties.site_name: Infineon Cegléd (Infineon Technologies Cegléd Kft. + Infineon Technologies Bipoláris Kft.)
package_types: bipolar high/medium-power semiconductors (pressure contact disc thyristors, disc diodes, bipolar modules)
properties.summary: Assembles and tests IGBT (power switch) modules and bipolar power parts such as disc thyristors and diodes. Opened in 1996 and employs 1,600 people.
Final testing of Bosch semiconductors. Bosch names Hatvan as one of four such test sites, with Reutlingen, Suzhou and Penang.
Final assembly and testing of Sensirion's digital sensor modules in Debrecen, Hungary. Opened in 2021, the plant has about 100 employees and is expanding.

properties.site_name: Tyndall National Institute — Photonic Packaging Group / Device Forensics (FlexiFab back-end)
properties.summary: Research site for photonic, MEMS and sensor packaging, plus device reliability testing. Run by University College Cork, it is not a commercial packaging plant.

properties.site_name: Intel Vigasio advanced packaging & assembly plant (planned)
properties.summary: Planned Intel chip packaging and assembly plant in Vigasio, Italy. In March 2024 Italy's industry minister said Intel had given up or postponed the project.
properties.notes: [2026-10-08] Status: on 14 Mar 2024 minister Adolfo Urso said Intel had 'given up or postponed' its Italian investment (Reuters); Intel declined to comment. An Intel plant would package Intel's own chips (captive).

properties.summary: STMicroelectronics is building packaging and test lines for SiC (silicon carbide) power devices and modules in Catania. Under construction, with production planned for 2026.
STMicroelectronics plant in Marcianise, Italy, for chip assembly and test. Captive site for its owner. Operational.
Announced panel level packaging plant for chiplet modules. Production is planned for 2028, with €1.3 billion of state aid approved by the European Commission.

package_types: automotive-grade packages (generic term "advanced chip packages"; no specific package family such as QFN/BGA/WLCSP disclosed)
properties.summary: Assembles and tests MEMS (micro machined) sensor packages and automotive chips in Kirkop, Malta. Opened in 1981, it has about 1,800 employees.

properties.company: Sensonor AS (Safran Sensing Technologies Norway AS)
package_types: hermetic MEMS sensor packages (gyroscopes, IMUs, pressure sensors)
properties.summary: Safran's own plant for hermetic MEMS (tiny moving sensor) packages such as gyroscopes, inertial units and pressure sensors. It opened in 1985 and has 63 employees.

properties.site_name: Intel Wrocław (Miękinia) Semiconductor Integration and Test Facility — CANCELLED, never built
properties.summary: Intel planned a chip assembly and test site near Wrocław, Poland, for 2,000 people. The project was cancelled.
Amkor packages and tests chips for outside customers, including wafer-level fan-out packages. The Vila do Conde plant opened in 1996 and has about 750 staff.

properties.company: KDPOF / KD (Knowledge Development for POF, S.L.)
properties.site_name: KD (KDPOF) Tres Cantos optoelectronic packaging and test facility
properties.summary: Packages and tests optoelectronic transceiver chips for optical communication. Opened in 2024 and now expanding. Owned by KDPOF.

properties.site_name: Aptasic SA (Boudry HQ, now Eurofins Materials & Engineering Sciences)
properties.summary: Tests ASIC chips and packages them in plastic or ceramic. It has about 27 staff and joined Eurofins in March 2026.
Assembles and tests IGBT (power switch), MOSFET, thyristor and SiC (silicon carbide) power modules in Lenzburg, Switzerland. It sits beside Hitachi Energy's own chip fabs and is expanding.

properties.site_name: ALTER UK (ALTER Technology TÜV NORD UK Ltd, formerly Optocap)
package_types: hermetic microelectronic/photonic packages (die attach, wire/ribbon bonding, hermetic sealing)
properties.summary: Contract packaging and test site (OSAT) for chips, MEMS sensors, image sensors and VCSEL lasers. It opened in 2003 and has 45 employees.

properties.site_name: CSA Catapult Innovation Centre — Advanced Packaging Prototype Facility / Power Packaging R&D Line
properties.summary: CSA Catapult runs a research and pilot line for packaging compound semiconductor power modules, including 3D printed ceramic packages. It opened in 2018 in Newport, Wales.

properties.site_name: Custom Interconnect Andover BP2 (Blueprint 2 OSAT facility)
package_types: power modules (BEV/PHEV power electronics, package families not itemized)
properties.summary: Custom Interconnect assembles and tests microelectronics in Andover, including flip-chip, wafer-level packages and power modules. It works as a contract packaging site with about 200 staff.
Assembles and tests custom high reliability modules using flip chip and wire bonding. Opened in 1983 and employs 130 people.

properties.site_name: Sivers Photonics — Hamilton International Technology Park
package_types: III-V InP laser diode chip-on-carrier/TO-can packaging
die/chip packaging for DFB and gain-chip lasers
photonic device packaging (not conventional IC leadframe/BGA/WLP)
properties.summary: Packages and tests indium phosphide (InP) laser diodes, including DFB lasers. The site also grows epitaxy layers and has about 80 staff.

properties.site_name: Diodes Neuhaus am Rennweg assembly and test
properties.summary: Assembly and test site for semiconductor devices in Neuhaus am Rennweg, Germany. Diodes Incorporated lists it as an assembly and test location in its 2025 annual report.
